why: The same window as 29 reached from the other stash origin — a framing failure rather than a grammar one — and closed by the other infallible terminal input. The disposition that comes out is the framing fault, not `outcome_unknown`: the bytes were already unreadable when the connection dropped, and terminality is first-writer-wins, so a transport error arriving afterwards must not relabel a protocol fault as a lost observation the caller may retry against.
